about: Intro track IN-2: Kappi's tips during a run, said only when you struggle or stall (logic/kappi-tips.js decides, kappi.js shows them). Each tip: its trigger (when), a world cue tried first (cue, after cueS seconds for a stall), the seconds a stall takes before Kappi speaks (s), and Kappi's line. Caps: never in a run's first battle, at most caps.place per place and caps.run per run, each tip once ever (meta.tipsSeen). Settings: Kappi's tips.

catch.line: Two misses. From my notes: a fresh Billie jumps right out. A tired one stays in.[p] Tire it first. #l:4da8

faint.line: Fainted, not gone. They nap it off.[p] Send in someone rested. A town’s clinic does the rest. #l:d2c9

potion.line: You carried a potion through that whole fight. I watched it [i]not[/i] get used.[p] It’s in the Bag. #l:c01a

pyramids.line: No pyramids left. Wild ones still fight, and fights pay.[p] Shops sell more. #l:bcf2

sheet.line: There’s no wrong choice here. Only a slow one.[p] Leaving counts as a choice. #l:2643

stall.line: Lovely spot. The arrows at the edge point the way on.[p] No hurry. I’m only noting it. #l:2611

counter.line: Its type beats yours. Brave.[p] Switching is brave too. Just less dramatic. #l:d1c5
